concerns.text: FR-004 mandates a 'spatial split (train: Eastern US, test: Western US)' for model evaluation. The tasks (T020, T022) and plan explicitly implement a 'temporal split' on the Lake Powell region only. No task exists to implement the required spatial split or handle the Western US test set, leaving FR-004 unimplemented.

FR-006 requires a 'Linear Mixed-Effects Model (LMM)' for statistical validation. The plan and tasks (T028-T029) substitute 'Bootstrap Resampling' without a corresponding task to implement the LMM. The LMM requirement is completely missing from the task list.
FR-007 requires generating 'continental-scale maps'. Task T032 only implements 'regional map generation' for the Lake Powell region. No task exists to generate the required continental visualization.

SC-001 requires measuring RMSE against a 'held-out test set (Western US 2022 data)'. As the tasks only generate a Lake Powell 2022 test set (T020), there is no task to produce or evaluate against the Western US data required by this success criterion.

SC-002 requires measuring statistical significance against the 'p-value threshold... from the Linear Mixed-Effects Model'. Since no task implements the LMM (see FR-006 concern), the measurement defined in SC-002 cannot be performed.
US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1 explicitly requires training with a 'spatial split (train: Eastern US, test: Western US)'. Task T020 implements a temporal split. No task covers the spatial split scenario.
US-3 Acceptance Scenario 1 requires executing a 'Linear Mixed-Effects Model (LMM)'. Tasks T028-T029 implement Bootstrap Resampling instead. No task exists to run the LMM.

Task T024 (Permutation Importance) is marked as incomplete/missing (checkbox unchecked) in the task list, yet FR-005 and SC-005 require permutation importance to verify robustness. While the task exists in the list, its incomplete status means the requirement is not currently covered by a completed task.
